files_summary.products.json: Array of products (product_id, name, category, price, stock).
files_summary.products_processed.csv: CSV mirror of products (product_id, name, category, price, stock).
files_summary.orders.csv: CSV of orders (order_id, product_id, quantity, customer, order_date, status).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: load_products_json
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full product catalog as a list of product records. This endpoint does not accept any parameters and refuses requests that include unexpected fields, because there is nothing to filter or modify.

tool_schemas.name: load_products_processed_csv
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full set of products as a list of product records from the processed catalog. This endpoint does not accept any parameters and refuses requests that include unexpected fields, because there is nothing to filter or modify.

tool_schemas.name: get_product_by_id
tool_schemas.description: Looks up a single product by its product_id and returns the product record when it exists; if it does not exist, it returns an explicit “found: false” result. It refuses requests missing product_id or where product_id is not a string, because it cannot perform a lookup without a valid identifier.

tool_schemas.name: list_products_by_category
tool_schemas.description: Returns a list of all products assigned to the specified category. It refuses requests missing category or where category is not a string, because it cannot filter products without a valid category name.
tool_schemas.implementation:
_DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0357000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0357000") else "/app/database")
def list_products_by_category(category):
    import json
    with open(__import__("os").path.join(_DB, 'products.json')) as f:
        ps = json.load(f)
    return [p for p in ps if p.get('category') == category]

tool_schemas.name: load_orders_csv
tool_schemas.description: Returns all orders, optionally filtered by customer (email) and/or status, and returns only orders matching the provided filters. It refuses requests where customer or status are provided but are not strings, or where unknown filter fields are included, because it only supports filtering by those two optional fields.

metadata.name: Atlas Catalog Finder
metadata.description: A backend service that loads product and order data and lets users browse the product catalog and retrieve products by ID or category via simple API endpoints.
